notes: #PCGGCOM, the ascent/abort guidance compool (resident: one copy on the volume, flat = halfword + 109968). STS-134's flown load changed 506 words (DASS_G16.ASC and DASS_G2.ASC PATCH SUMMARY agree).  Patched here: only the words that the KSC6 tape still holds at the generic load-module value AND that no launch-day path sets -- not the variables the tape already carries launch-day values for (THET/PSI/PHI, winds, throttles, masses, launch year, RNP day, plane, MECO targets: the DASS values for these are the 2010 tape build's, superseded on the day), not the ranges examples/flights/sts134-dolilu.json uplinks (GMESTA ops 15, 25, 37, 96: DOLILU stays authoritative), and not CGGS_PPOLY/CGGS_DELPLO, the first-stage attitude-table velocity breakpoints and limit that the DOLILU THET/PSI/PHI tables were shaped against.  What is left: CGES_OMS_ASSIST_DELAY (nominal OMS assist), the engine-out/abort steering constants (GGNSSM), the RTLS targets (CGGS_TARGETn, GMESTA op 88, which the DOLILU file does not send), CGGS_V_KMAX_DOWN/UP (op 89), CGGS_NZSW1 and CGGS_GRNZC1.  Apply on top of the KSC6 volume (or sts134-gnc-iloads.json).  See yaGPC2/ASCENT_ILOADS.md.
